en: a is for apple. It is round with a little tail.
b is for bus. It has a tall line with a round tummy at the bottom on the right.
c is for cake. It is a round shape with a gap on the right.
d is for dolphin. It has a round tummy on the left and a tall line on the right.
e is for elephant. It has a little line across the middle.
f is for frog. It has a hook at the top and a line across.
g is for grapes. It has a round top and a tail that curls under.
h is for house. It has a tall line and a little hump.
i is for ice skate. It is a short line with a dot on top.
j is for joystick. It has a dot on top and a tail that hooks to the left.
k is for key. It has a tall line and two little arms.
l is for lemon. It is one tall straight line with no dot.
m is for moon. It has two humps.
n is for notes. It has one hump.
o is for octopus. It is a round circle with no gap.
p is for penguin. Its line goes down below and the round part is on the right.
q has a round part on the left and a straight tail going down.
r is for rabbit. It is a short line with a little arm at the top.
s is for sun. It curves like a snake.
t is for tree. It has a line across near the top and a little curl at the bottom.
u is for umbrella. It is like a cup that is open at the top.
v has two straight lines that meet at the bottom, like a pointy cup.
w is for watermelon. It has two pointy dips at the bottom.
x is made of two lines that cross in the middle.
y has two short arms and a long tail going down.
z is for zebra. It has a line on top, a line on the bottom and a slope between them.
Which is the big letter M?
M is for Mouse. Big M has two tall lines with a pointy dip in the middle.
Which is the big letter T?
T is for Tiger. Big T has one line across the top and one line down.
Which is the big letter S?
S is for Snake. Big S bends like a snake.
Which is the big letter H?
H is for Horse. Big H has two tall lines joined across the middle.

example.why_en: a is for apple. It is round with a little tail.

en.title: Letter names
en.teach: Every letter has a name and a shape. Look closely: b, d and p look alike, but each one faces a different way.
